capabilities: Expand the ribbon on hover with labelled actions over content
Pin the ribbon open so the editor makes room for it
Drag or keyboard-resize the ribbon width between 120 and 300 px
Reorder ribbon icons and keep order, pin state and width across restarts
Provide reversible fallback buttons for obsolete plugin icons
extras: Requires desktop Obsidian 1.13.7 or later; manual installation is done by extracting the release ZIP into the vault's .obsidian/plugins/ directory. The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice.
intentEvidence: Make Obsidian's left ribbon easier to use with labelled actions.
problem: Obsidian's left ribbon shows only icons, so its actions are hard to identify and it occupies space without a way to expand or resize it.
summary: Left-ribbon enhancement that shows labelled icon actions on hover, can be pinned open, and is resizable from 120 to 300 px.
